summary: Conditionally locks a 96-byte region of an audio buffer for writing. Reads the buffer base pointer at this+0x114C; if non-null, computes a sub-offset inside the buffer from this+0x1148 and calls BufferLockAllocate (00540F00) with (this, buffer_base + 36 * sub_index, 96, 0, 0). Returns 0 immediately when the buffer pointer is null. Invoked by sub_5613E0 (005613E0).

operations.description: Default return value result = 0 is established before the buffer check.
Guard on the buffer base pointer this[0x114C] (this[1107]): when null the function returns 0 immediately; the buffer is not allocated or not ready.
Lock target = buffer_base(this[0x114C]) + 36 * this[0x1148] (this[1106]); the sub-index at 0x1148 selects which 96-byte region of the buffer to address.
Call BufferLockAllocate(this, computed_lock_target, 96, 0, 0) to lock (prepare for write) the 96-byte region.
Return the BufferLockAllocate result when the buffer pointer was non-null, otherwise return 0.
Invoked by sub_5613E0 (005613E0) to clear a selected region of an audio buffer.
